title: Requirement Completion and Replacement Cover: Retention on a Named Insured's Cancellation (Named Non-Owner Policy)
content:
On a Named Non-Owner Policy term cancelled at the named insured's request, the reason recorded on the signed cancellation request and the named insured's Operator certificate on file set a multiplier of the package's insured-cancellation retention percentage. The multiplier is applied to that percentage before the reduction is taken from the unearned premium.

**Operator certificate on file.** The named insured's Operator certificate on file is the SR-22 Operator Certificate or FR-44 Operator Certificate filing of the named insured whose status is filed, the FR-44 one when both are filed and the one recorded first when two of a form are filed; a certificate whose SR-26 has been sent has the status cancellation filed and is not on file; Owner and Owner-Operator certificates are not Operator certificates, and the term's own record of the certificate it was written to back is not read. These filings are the named insured's records with the Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) product.

**Clause.**
- A request whose reason is that the requirement ended, from a named insured whose Operator certificate on file carries a required-through date on or before the cancellation effective date, multiplies the retention by 0.5.
- A request whose reason is replacement with other insurance, from a named insured with no Operator certificate on file, multiplies it by 0.75.
- Every other request leaves the retention unchanged.

| Request reason | Operator certificate on file | Its required-through date | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| requirement ended | yes | on or before the cancellation effective date | 0.5 |
| requirement ended | yes | after the cancellation effective date | none |
| requirement ended | no | — | none |
| replaced with other insurance | no | — | 0.75 |
| replaced with other insurance | yes | — | none |
| any other reason | either | — | none |

*Hypothetical:* a request citing that the requirement ended, effective 30 September, from a named insured whose filed SR-22 Operator certificate is required through 30 September: the boundary date counts as on or before, so the multiplier is 0.5. An SR-22 whose SR-26 has already been sent is not on file; a request citing replacement with other insurance from that named insured carries 0.75.
